title: Docker Run: Rootless pi Container (bash)
description: Run course-pi-ollama container as current user with security hardening and workspace mount.

steps.description: Interactive: -it flags for interactive terminal session.
User mapping: --user maps container UID/GID to host user.
Volume and workspace: binds current directory as /workspace, sets working directory.
Model selection: environment variable sets the Ollama model to use.
